component.name: Kaint
component.summary: Edit images with layers and effects
Edita imágenes con capas y efectos

description.p: Kaint is a raster image editor that recreates the look, the tools and the workflow of Paint.NET as a native Qt application. It is made for KDE Plasma and also follows the light or dark style of other desktops.

Kaint es un editor de imágenes que recrea el aspecto, las herramientas y la forma de trabajar de Paint.NET como una aplicación nativa de Qt. Está hecho para KDE Plasma y también sigue el estilo claro u oscuro de otros escritorios.

ul.li: Selections with combine modes, move pixels with scale and rotation, brushes, clone stamp, recolor, paint bucket, gradients, lines, curves, shapes and text
Selecciones con modos de combinación, mover píxeles con escala y giro, pinceles, tampón de clonar, recolorear, bote de pintura, degradados, líneas, curvas, formas y texto
Editable history: gradients, lines, shapes, text and fills stay editable when you go back to their step
Historial editable: degradados, líneas, formas, texto y rellenos se pueden seguir editando al volver a su paso
Layers with blend modes, opacity and live thumbnails
Capas con modos de fusión, opacidad y miniaturas en directo
Adjustments and effects with live preview
Ajustes y efectos con vista previa en directo
Paint.NET effect plugins and native plugins with a C API
Complementos de efectos de Paint.NET y complementos nativos con una API en C
OpenRaster projects with layers, PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, BMP, TIFF, TGA, animated GIF and ICO, and opens Paint.NET .pdn files
Proyectos OpenRaster con capas, PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, BMP, TIFF, TGA, GIF animado e ICO, y abre archivos .pdn de Paint.NET
Light, dark and custom themes, and recovery copies of unsaved images
Temas claro, oscuro y personalizados, y copias de recuperación de las imágenes sin guardar

description.p: Kaint is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by dotPDN LLC. Paint.NET is a trademark of dotPDN LLC.
Kaint es un proyecto independiente, sin relación con dotPDN LLC ni respaldado por ella. Paint.NET es una marca registrada de dotPDN LLC.

screenshot.caption: The dark theme with the tools, colors, history and layers windows
El tema oscuro con las ventanas de herramientas, colores, historial y capas

description.p: Collaborative mode, over the Internet or on the local network, between Kaint and the web version.

ul.li: Edit the current image together: over the Internet with P2P (share the session code; the image goes straight from one computer to the other) or on the local network, where nearby sessions are found automatically

Real time between copies of Kaint; guests can also suggest their changes from a private draft, and the host accepts them (between Kaint and the web, always): they appear in the history as "Change made by…"
Colored pointers with each person's name and tool, open, approved, password-protected or ID-only sessions, and only the host saves the image
The session image's tab turns yellow, with a crown (is the host's image saved?) and, for guests, a computer (is your exported copy up to date?)
The host's history for everyone, and going back to an earlier version for everyone (the host, and the guests it allows)
Icon pack editor: create your own icon pack, side by side with Kaint's icons, and export it as a .zip
The Paintbrush is selected when Kaint starts, sharper image thumbnails, and the ruler's pointer mark grows with the zoom to the size of a pixel
Its own section in Settings, with a simplified and a compact view; addresses and session codes stay blurred until clicked, with a button to copy them
Dropping an image asks whether to open it or add it as a layer; Save All; color gradients in Hue / Saturation and smoother Curves
Windows 7 Dark theme with smoked glass, a Windows-like opening animation for windows, and the Zalgo button in the Text tool
Fixes: Kaint's title bar buttons on Windows, white text with the Windows 7 theme when Windows is in dark mode, and the Colors window drawing the glass behind the color wheel

description.p: Desktop support for paint.js plugins, more image formats everywhere and a tidier phone version.

ul.li: Support for paint.js plugins (.paintjs), the same ones as the web version: their effects and file types (Photoshop PSD with layers, for example), run in a sandboxed JavaScript engine with no access to your files or the internet
The web version's plugin catalog, behind a button you can turn on in Settings → Plugins
TGA, DDS and QOI open and save on every system, without depending on Qt's image plugins
Kaint's own title bar and window frame can also be used on Windows
Phone version: windows hidden in the corners stay out of each other's way, the File menu lives in the save button and the menus fit in one row

description.p: Saving as Paint.NET files, customizable menus and title bars, and a phone-friendly web version.

ul.li: Save as Paint.NET (.pdn), with layers, blend modes, resolution and thumbnail
Move any effect, plugin ones too, to another menu or submenu, hide effects and reorder the Tools window
Turn single effects of a plugin on or off; native plugins can bring their own icon (plugin API 2)
Animated GIFs open as layers or as separate images, and save from the layers or from the open images you pick
On Linux, title bar buttons like those of Windows 11, 10, 7, XP or 98 or macOS, on the right or on the left
Paint.NET style: a Windows 11 recreation with rounded windows and slider tracks like Paint.NET's
Windows 7, Windows XP and Windows 98 ALT themes, based on 7.css, XP.css and 98.css, with their window frames on floating windows and dialogs
Floating windows are translucent only while they cover the image, like Paint.NET

description.p: Plugins from PhotoCraft and LightCraft, a sharper brush and a closer Paint.NET look.

ul.li: PhotoCraft filter plugins (.wasm) run sandboxed in Kaint's own WebAssembly interpreter
LightCraft looks (.cube, .3dl) and develop presets (.xmp), with an Amount slider
A crisper paintbrush, with Paint.NET's soft edge and smoothing that does not lag behind
Paint.NET style: gray and blue bar sliders, hollow handles, a shape grid and wider dash styles
On Linux, a Windows 10 (or Windows 98) title bar drawn by Kaint, with its shadow from KWin
Floating windows snap to the edges and to each other; interface font and top bar color in Settings
A Preview box in effect dialogs and a negative Gamma Boost in the blurs
Nearest Neighbor sampling stays sharp when shrinking with Move Selected Pixels
The Paint.NET style and cursors are now the defaults

description.p: Paint.NET-style cursors, the Blue theme and closer Paint.NET behavior.

ul.li: Optional Paint.NET cursors in pixel art, chosen in Settings or on first start
The hand near the edges of a selection stretches it with the Move tools
New Bilinear Multisample and Anisotropic sampling for Move Selected Pixels
New Blue theme, and rulers that follow the theme in light mode
Canvas settings with a color wheel for the canvas border, like Paint.NET
The cursor position stays visible after leaving the canvas
On Windows, the title bar stays active while a Kaint dialog is open and cursors are smaller
Page Setup removed from the File menu (it could crash on Windows)

description.p: Fixes for the cursors and new icons in the main toolbar.

ul.li: Cursors with a tool thumbnail follow the pointer size chosen in KDE or GTK and play animated pointers
On Windows, those cursors are no longer blurry or distorted with custom pointers
New Cut, Copy, Paste, Crop to Selection and Deselect icons in the main toolbar

description.p: A Paint.NET style for the interface, a welcome window and many fixes.

ul.li: New Paint.NET interface style, more compact and without borders, next to Kaint's own
A welcome window on the first start with the theme, style, language and Discord options
Open and Save As use the system file dialog
Cursors with a tool thumbnail use the system pointer
Layers follow the mouse while dragged in the Layers window
Fixed selection outlines, the background shifting while moving pixels and the font chooser

description.p: Animations, icon packs, editable shortcuts and a web version.

ul.li: Animations for menus, windows, layers and colors, with a switch in Settings
New interface icons, icon packs and editable keyboard shortcuts
Fonts and Paint.NET shapes can be added from Settings
Windows 10 style floating windows with a configurable border, and new rulers
Tool cursors with their icons and an exact zoom to a rectangle
Windows installer with an uninstaller
KaintHTML, Kaint for the web
New application ID: io.github.ssserch.Kaint
Paint.NET plugins work in the Flatpak, with mono included
Paint bucket and pixel art fixes

description.p: Fixes for the Windows version and nicer effect previews.
Windows support with build.bat, Paint.NET plugins on Windows, new icons and a restart when the language changes.
